name: A Dusty Unsent Letter
summary: In Westfall, a dusty letter sheds light on Stalvan Mistmantle’s past in Moonbrook. The unsent parchment was found in an old footlocker and confirms that he lived there before his disappearance.

sections.title: A Clue in the Dust
sections.body: Investigators searching for Stalvan Mistmantle’s past find an unsent letter in an old footlocker in Moonbrook. Darkshire’s town registry still gives his last address as the Moonbrook Schoolhouse, and Clerk Daltry wants to know whether he truly lived there. The letter confirms that Stalvan resided in the Westfall township for a time. Finding it disturbs a vengeful Forlorn Spirit, which guards the remnants of Stalvan’s past with bitter malice.

sections.title: Updating the Registry
sections.body: Clerk Daltry receives the letter at Darkshire’s Town Hall as evidence for the town registry. He finds it strange that the correspondence was never sent and hints at the trail Stalvan left across the southern kingdoms of the Alliance.

aliases: where to get dusty unsent letter
faq.answer: The letter is found in an abandoned footlocker in Moonbrook, Westfall, among dilapidated houses overrun by the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: Why was the letter never sent?
faq.answer: The reason the letter was never sent is uncertain. Clerk Daltry finds it suspicious and suggests Stalvan may have fled Moonbrook in haste or left his correspondence behind before moving on.

faq.q: Who needs to see this letter?
aliases: who do i give the letter to
faq.answer: Clerk Daltry needs to see the letter. He manages the town registry inside Darkshire’s Town Hall.

faq.q: Why does a spirit attack when finding it?
faq.answer: Disturbing the footlocker summons a Forlorn Spirit tied to Stalvan’s haunting legacy. It attacks anyone prying into his forgotten life and afflicts intruders with the debilitating Curse of Stalvan.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, learning Stalvan’s trail helps Darkshire keep accurate records of travelers and outcasts moving between human settlements in Westfall and Duskwood.
